senses.sense_definition: A state or act of violating faith or allegiance; violation of a promise or vow, or of trust.

examples.text: The politician's <w>perfidy</w> shocked his supporters who had trusted his promises.
She could not forgive the <w>perfidy</w> of her business partner after he stole the company funds.

senses.sense_definition: A state or act of deceit.

examples.text: The public was outraged by the <w>perfidy</w> of the corporation that hid the safety risks.
He was known for his <w>perfidy</w> and could never be relied upon to tell the truth.

senses.sense_definition: An illegitimate act of deception in warfare, such as using protected symbols to gain an advantage.

examples.text: Using a white flag to lure the enemy into an ambush is considered an act of <w>perfidy</w>.
The military commander was accused of <w>perfidy</w> for misusing the Red Cross emblem during the battle.
